name: Food Delivery
description: Deep links that hand a place off to popular food-ordering platforms, pre-filled with the restaurant name and delivery location. No live menu, price, or delivery data is fetched.

ubereats.purpose: Deep link to order from Uber Eats for the selected restaurant, pre-filling its name and delivery location.
ubereats.dataSent: None sent by OpenMapX for the deep link itself — an outbound link (carrying the restaurant name and, when known, the coordinates/address/city/postcode as URL parameters) is opened in your browser only when you click it. Separately, an optional server-side lookup may send the restaurant name and a delivery location to Uber Eats' store-feed endpoint to resolve the exact store page; this runs on the OpenMapX server, not in your browser.
ubereats.dataReceived: Only for the optional server-side lookup: a list of matching store names, URLs, and map markers used to pick the closest branch. The deep link itself returns nothing to OpenMapX.
